$comment: Every `code` a contract 2 add-on writes in a problem+json body. type is urn:syndra:addon:error:<code>. retry: never, backoff (transient), retry_after (honour Retry-After), replan (re-plan, then apply), by_status (read the status). Removed from major 1: SCOPE_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT_REQUIRED (the backend owns acknowledgement, design §11).

APPLY_BLOCKED.title: Apply blocked
APPLY_BLOCKED.meaning: The apply was refused with an outcome (effect blocked); the outcome fields ride as extension members.

APPLY_FAILED.title: Apply failed
APPLY_FAILED.meaning: An apply could not be completed; the status says whether retrying can help.

BAD_REQUEST.title: Bad request
BAD_REQUEST.meaning: A required field is missing (call_id, subject) or the body is not JSON.

BINDING_CONFLICT.title: Binding conflict
BINDING_CONFLICT.meaning: An unbound target account already holds the derived name; the conflict rides as an extension member. An operator adopts or renames.

CALL_ID_REUSED.title: Call id reused
CALL_ID_REUSED.meaning: The call id was used before with a different identity (draft-ietf-httpapi-idempotency-key-header: 422; 409 is for a request still in flight).

CALL_IN_PROGRESS.title: Call in progress
CALL_IN_PROGRESS.meaning: A request with this call id is executing in this process now; Retry-After is present.

CALL_UNSETTLED.title: Call unsettled
CALL_UNSETTLED.meaning: A physical operation for this subject has an intent with no recorded result; nothing may re-execute it until it settles.

CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.title: Contract version mismatch
CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.meaning: The body's contract_version is not the one this add-on speaks; both numbers are in the body.

FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED.title: Fingerprint required
FINGERPRINT_REQUIRED.meaning: An apply carried no fingerprint, so there is nothing to verify the plan against.

FRESH_READ_COOLDOWN.title: Fresh read cooldown
FRESH_READ_COOLDOWN.meaning: A fresh read was asked for inside the cooldown and the add-on has nothing to serve; Retry-After is present.

INVALID_BODY.title: Invalid body
INVALID_BODY.meaning: The setting write body is not valid.

LIFECYCLE_REFUSAL.title: Lifecycle refusal
LIFECYCLE_REFUSAL.meaning: The add-on is draining or read-only and declined a mutation; Retry-After is always present. Detected by this code alone.

NOT_A_HOME_PLACE.title: Not a home place
NOT_A_HOME_PLACE.meaning: The value is not a folder the target offers for home folders.

NO_CURRENT_READ.title: No current read
NO_CURRENT_READ.meaning: The target could not be read and the add-on holds no mirror to serve instead.

NO_SUCH_SETTING.title: No such setting
NO_SUCH_SETTING.meaning: The named setting does not exist.

OPERATION_FAILED.title: Operation failed
OPERATION_FAILED.meaning: An operation could not be completed, or does not exist (404); the status says whether retrying can help.

OPERATION_MISMATCH.title: Operation mismatch
OPERATION_MISMATCH.meaning: The operation named in the body is not the one the route runs.

PLAN_STALE.title: Plan stale
PLAN_STALE.meaning: The subject changed on the target since the plan; re-plan before applying.

PLAN_TOO_LARGE.title: Plan too large
PLAN_TOO_LARGE.meaning: The plan carries more subjects than limits.subjects_per_plan; the limit is in the body.

REACH_NEVER_READ.title: Reach never read
REACH_NEVER_READ.meaning: The folder permissions have not been read since the add-on started.

REASON_REQUIRED.title: Reason required
REASON_REQUIRED.meaning: A lifecycle change must carry a reason.

SETTINGS_UNREADABLE.title: Settings unreadable
SETTINGS_UNREADABLE.meaning: The settings could not be read from the add-on's store.

SETTING_NOT_SAVED.title: Setting not saved
SETTING_NOT_SAVED.meaning: The setting could not be stored.

STORE_UNREADABLE.title: Store unreadable
STORE_UNREADABLE.meaning: The add-on's local store could not be read.

TARGET_UNREACHABLE.title: Target unreachable
TARGET_UNREACHABLE.meaning: The target cannot be reached and the add-on has nothing to serve; Retry-After is present. Never a lifecycle refusal.

TARGET_UNREADABLE.title: Target unreadable
TARGET_UNREADABLE.meaning: The target could not be read; the status distinguishes rate-limiting, unreachable and failing.

TARGET_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.title: Target version unsupported
TARGET_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED.meaning: A mutation against a target major this add-on has not been tested with.

UNAUTHENTICATED.title: Unauthenticated
UNAUTHENTICATED.meaning: The request signature is missing or wrong; the add-on does not say which half.

UNKNOWN_FIELD.title: Unknown field
UNKNOWN_FIELD.meaning: The field is not in the entitlement schema.

UNKNOWN_LIFECYCLE_STATE.title: Unknown lifecycle state
UNKNOWN_LIFECYCLE_STATE.meaning: The state is not one of active, draining, read_only.

UNKNOWN_METRIC.title: Unknown metric
UNKNOWN_METRIC.meaning: The metric is not in the manifest.

UNKNOWN_REQUEST_FIELD.title: Unknown request field
UNKNOWN_REQUEST_FIELD.meaning: The strict decoder met a field the route does not know.
